scope: Retrospective bounded task224 repair; no old or new generator calls, thresholds or semantic phrase variants
parser: Independently trained spaCy en_core_web_sm3.7.1, repository revision8fb6f8155286360bf5486fe399e2738d1df7ded2; spaCy3.7.5 CPU, Python3.12; isolated ignored environment
source_architecture: Retain all complete bounded source sentences with exact edition/provenance/offsets, including sentences unknown to finite FactFrames. Parser emits whole-sentence dependency trees; no deletion of negation, quantifiers, conditions, temporal clauses, formulas or unknown tails. Distinct typed sentence/ground namespaces. Graph identity is necessary evidence for a conservative prototype, not universal entailment.
canonicalization: Only case/lemma with number/tense retained, punctuation excluded, active/passive subject-object normalization with explicit by-agent and matching tense. No synonyms, semantic similarity, NLI, expected labels or case/entity/title allowlists. Pronouns unresolved => withhold. Claim conjunctions and extra sentences cannot be dropped. Each complete claim sentence must match a whole source sentence structure; copied source text is labeled extractive and never useful generated success.
evaluation: Freeze constructed syntax/role/condition/formula/negation controls before parser inference. Replay every actual task224 prose draft and preserve all103 prior inputs plus994 scores. No generative retries. Source-inspect all candidate outputs. Report parse coverage separately from entailment, usefulness and literal copying. Require zero unsupported eligible, all absent withheld and at least1complete useful non-extractive generated answer for positive result; otherwise preserve negative.
limits: No network inference. CPU single parser process, max1GiB model artifact,512tokens/sentence,6sourcepassages and existing1200UTF16bounded window. Host parser is not Android runtime qualification. Production model.env/native/admission unchanged.
